verdict.rationale: ReadMe serves a live llms.txt with search and markdown mirrors of every doc page, plus scores docs against an 'Agent-Friendly Docs' spec and exposes a per-project MCP server for agent access — all verified via runtime probes, not just claims. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-ReadMe) confirmation that external agents successfully consume these llms.txt/agent-oriented docs in practice.
